# Use internal base image (includes uv, Python 3.12, Debian bookworm)
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock ./
ENV UV_CACHE_DIR=/app/.cache/uv
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --no-cache --no-dev

# Copy the application code
COPY src/ src/
COPY config/ config/

# Create data directory
RUN mkdir -p data \
    && chown -R 1001:1001 /app

USER 1001:1001 

# Expose the port the app runs on
EXPOSE 8000

# Command to run the application
CMD ["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "uvicorn", "src.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]=====
